description:
Give developers confidence that integrating (or upgrading) the Martech SDK has not broken their app's analytics, attribution or billing wiring.

Scope: tooling that runs AROUND the SDK and proves an integration is correct. This epic changes no SDK source code — that belongs in MTSDK-2 (Developer Experience).

The outcome is threefold:
- A verification suite that asserts Amplitude events, Amplitude<->RevenueCat identity and AppsFlyer identity wiring are intact
- That suite running in CI, green, against at least two real apps
- A playbook that tells an app team how to integrate AND how to prove they didn't break anything

Open question owned by this epic (see MTSDK-10): whether verification reads back from the vendor APIs, or asserts at the SDK boundary. That is a go/no-go decision, not a build task, and it gates everything else here.
